name: Astra factory air-raid shelter, Gernika
story: Gernika's arms industry, which made the famous Astra pistols, was one of the few potentially military targets in the town. In September 1936 the Talleres de Gernika factory built two concrete shelters for its workers. They were disguised under false roofs, and the bombers did not recognise them as shelters on 26 April 1937. The factory buildings on the edge of town largely survived the raid, a fact often cited in the debate over what the attack was really aiming at. The former Astra site is now a cultural centre.
see: A concrete shelter in the former Astra factory area on Ibarra Kalea.
plan: A 10-minute walk from the Peace Museum. Check with the tourist office about access to the interior.
